# verdicts3 -- verdicts over a machine-form candidate set

Rows are CLUSTER groups (same bytes, or same anchored
lifted form) and CONNECTION groups (the same maximal
sub-term over the anchored variables).  A row is never
named by an operator token.  Each member carries its
token as a display label only.
